values.meaning: Total Heal over the zone's duration

values.quote: for 6 seconds that follows the nearest allied champion

values.binNote: Wiki tooltip states heal ticks every 0.25s (25 ticks over 6s: 70/25 to 150/25 per tick), while MilioW.HealFrequencySeconds = 3 in the bin; these disagree and the wiki text is used here since it directly describes the tick rate and matches the per-tick math shown in the leveling table.

values.quote: placing the recast on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}}}-second {{tt|static|Unaffected by ability haste}} cooldown
values.binNote: No dedicated bin data value found for the recast's own cooldown; the wiki states it separately from the main W cooldown and from MilioW.DecayDelay-type fields, so it is recorded without a bin source.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown begins only after the ability's effect resolves, not on cast.
Only allied champions near the fuemigo receive the heal and attack range bonus, and the range bonus persists even if they leave the zone.
mechanics.quote: The {{sti|attack range}} increase lingers on allies for the entire duration of ''Cozy Campfire'', even if they leave the zone.

mechanics.claim: Milio himself counts as an allied champion and can receive Cozy Campfire's heal and range bonus.
mechanics.quote: '''''Milio''' counts as an allied champion for this ability.

mechanics.claim: Casting or recasting Cozy Campfire can grant Milio's Fired Up! passive buff, at most once every 3 seconds.
mechanics.quote: Cozy Campfire may grant {{ai|Fired Up!|Milio}} upon being summoned and at most once every 3 seconds thereafter.

mechanics.claim: The ability can be recast within the duration to move the fuemigo to a target ally, on its own static 0.5s cooldown unaffected by ability haste.
mechanics.quote: placing the recast on a {{sti|cd|{{fd|0.5}}}}-second {{tt|static|Unaffected by ability haste}} cooldown
